name: A Magical Affront

angles.text: As a Mage, you may see the surfaced leylines on Zephras as a rare chance to study raw mystical energy directly. Their preservation matters to your arcane craft.
As a Druid, you may feel the tension in the Windshapers’ view of the exposed leylines as wounds across the natural land, in need of healing.

As a Shaman, you may share the Windshapers’ elemental and natural stewardship as they seek to calm and heal disturbances across Zephras. That puts their aims at odds with orders harnessing raw magical flows.

faq.answer: The Windshapers are a group on Zephras who see the surfaced leylines as unnatural wounds in the land. They seek to heal them, putting them at odds with orders that study and channel the leylines.

The order needs access to the surfaced leylines to deepen its understanding of magic. The Windshapers try to suppress or mend them, so the order sees their efforts as a threat and sends you to drive them off.
faq.q: Why does the order want the Windshapers driven off?

faq.answer: Leylines are conduits of mystical energy that traverse the world. On Zephras, they have recently broken through the earth, exposing raw magic and giving arcane practitioners direct access to study it.
faq.q: What are the leylines on Zephras?

faq.answer: The contested leyline lies in the forest southwest on Zephras. Windshapers have gathered there to close or mend the exposed surge of magic.
faq.q: Where is the contested leyline located?

aliases: why do windshapers want to heal leylines
faq.answer: The Windshapers see the sudden rupture of raw subterranean energy through the earth as violent scars across Zephras. They believe mending those tears will restore natural balance, which puts them at odds with spellcasters who want the leylines left open.
faq.q: Why do the Windshapers consider the leylines scars?

aliases: where does a magical affront take place
faq.answer: Zephras is where the leylines have recently emerged at the surface. Their raw magic has made the land a flashpoint between those who seek to master its arcane power and those who see the breaches as wounds to heal.
faq.q: What is the significance of Zephras in this conflict?

sections.body: Ancient conduits of raw magic have recently broken through the earth on Zephras. For scholars and practitioners of the local order, this is a rare boon. Direct contact with the leylines gives them new insight into the arcane currents across the region and deepens their mastery of magic.
sections.title: Unveiled Currents

sections.body:
The Windshapers see the exposed energies as open wounds and scars across Zephras. They gather at the rupture sites to suppress or mend the leylines and heal the earth.

The order depends on that raw power, so it sees their efforts as a threat. It sends you southwest into the forest to drive the Windshapers back.
sections.title: Scars and Strife

summary: On Zephras, A Magical Affront sets the local order against the Windshapers. The order seeks to harness and study the surfaced leylines, while the Windshapers see them as scars to heal. Their conflict has reached the southwestern forest.
